principle: Culture is learned, contextual, compositional and individually adopted; species is never a culture lock.
rules: One character may belong to multiple cultural contexts.
Homeworld does not uniquely determine culture.
Species does not uniquely determine culture.
Citizenship and faction membership do not uniquely determine culture.
Culture supplies norms, expectations, references and probability priors, not compulsory personality scripts.
A character may selectively adopt, reinterpret or reject norms.
Cultural familiarity is knowledge/experience and may differ from cultural identity.
AI may use only culture state actually attached to the character/context.
